LESSON: HADITH ON GREETINGS

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Hadith 2.1 Hadith on good Behaviour (3 Lessons) By the end of the sub - strand, 
Topic 2.2: Hadith on Greetings

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Hadith on Greetings. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: which, if you do, you will love one another?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. practise Islamic greetings to promote love and unity in the society
2. appreciate the use of Islamic greetings in bringing harmony in the society

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: HADITH ON GREETINGS
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 5
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Hadith on Greetings helps you succeed in ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: HADITH ON GREETINGS
Study Hadith on Greetings like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Practise Islamic greetings to promote love and unity in the society

What this means
In this part you learn to practise Islamic greetings to promote love and unity in the society. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: practise Islamic greetings to promote love and unity in the society.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Hadith on Greetings” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can practise Islamic greetings to promote love and unity in the society. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Appreciate the use of Islamic greetings in bringing harmony in the society

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate the use of Islamic greetings in bringing harmony in the society. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate the use of Islamic greetings in bringing harmony in the society.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Hadith on Greetings in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate the use of Islamic greetings in bringing harmony in the society. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Hadith on Greetings is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Hadith on Greetings” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: practise Islamic greetings to promote love and unity in the society)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Hadith on Greetings in your own words. (skill: appreciate the use of Islamic greetings in bringing harmony in the society)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Hadith on Greetings to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: practise Islamic greetings to promote love and unity in the society.
3. Practise this skill: appreciate the use of Islamic greetings in bringing harmony in the society.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Hadith on Greetings from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Hadith on Greetings: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 5 learner study Hadith on Greetings?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. which, if you do, you will love one another?
2. Why should a Muslim use Islamic greeting?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Hadith on Greetings means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: practise Islamic greetings to promote love and unity in the society.
5. Be able to: appreciate the use of Islamic greetings in bringing harmony in the society.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
